questions.text: What is an emergency fund for?
questions.explanation: An emergency fund covers unexpected expenses, such as an urgent repair.

questions.text: What usually happens if you pay only the minimum on your credit card each month?

options.text: You take longer to repay and pay more interest

questions.explanation: Paying only the minimum usually means more time to repay and more interest.

questions.text: How does compound interest grow your savings?

options.text: You earn interest on your savings and on past interest
You earn interest only on the money you first saved
Your savings grow by the same fixed amount forever

questions.explanation: You earn interest on the money you saved and on interest already added.
